description: Open the spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/march_bills_raw.xlsx. The file contains March bills and notes about payment adjustments (Jordan pre-paid for internet, February utility credit, Alex's debt, Sam traveling). Create a new sheet called 'March Reconciliation'. Calculate the total bills ($2610), divide by 4 roommates ($652.50 each). Apply adjustments: Alex owes $688.75 (base + $40 Feb debt - $3.75 credit), Jordan owes $640.75 (base - $8 overpayment - $3.75 credit). Create a summary table showing roommate names, base shares, adjustments, and final amounts. Add a note explaining Sam's expenses are deferred to April. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
